description: Preset parameter reads / writes through the single write choke point, and the runtime (session) parameters.

commands.name: param.get
commands.title: Read a parameter
commands.description: Reads preset parameters. parameter: string | mode | gauss | gauss_flat | gauss_full | hammer | excitation | feedin | feedback | feedin_mask | feedback_mask | sound_channel | sound_channel_mask | string_sound_channel. key_no: a mode number for `mode`; a PITCH number for every other parameter (feedin / feedback / masks rows are indexed by mode); 'all' or 'from<a>to<b>' for ranges.

key_no.description: Mode number (mode) or pitch number (all other domains); 'all'; 'from<a>to<b>'

commands.name: param.set
commands.title: Write a parameter
commands.description: Writes preset parameters through the choke point (read-only guard, state_changed broadcast, one undo step). values has the same structure the matching param.get returns. Key space as param.get: feedin / feedback / masks / sound_channel are keyed by PITCH (output pitches >= 128 only for feedback / feedback_mask).

key_no.description: Mode number (mode) or pitch number (all other domains); 'all'; 'from<a>to<b>'

values.description: Payload in the GET shape of the same parameter

commands.name: runtime.get
commands.title: Read the runtime parameters
commands.description: Live session parameters: volume_level (slider 0-127), feedback, volume_center, volume_range, gate.

commands.name: runtime.set
commands.title: Set the runtime parameters
commands.description: volume: slider level 0-127 MIDI. feedback: 0 = silence, 1-127 MIDI-mapped (64 = 1.0), other values a direct coefficient. feedback_coeff: direct effective coefficient (bypasses the mapping). store_feedback_coeff: the per-preset stored baseline (in memory until save).
